description: This file defines configuration options and a validator class for a simple queue cache in the Orleans framework. It includes a class for cache options with a default size, and a validator class that checks the cache size validity.

classes.name: SimpleQueueCacheOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the simple queue cache, including cache size and default value.

classes.name: SimpleQueueCacheOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the SimpleQueueCacheOptions instance, ensuring cache size is positive.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Checks if the cache size is greater than zero; throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new validator instance using service provider and name.
